subjects.name: Fake bomb detectors (Gopher, Quadro Tracker, GT200, ADE 651)

summary: An empty golf-ball-finder gag gift was rebranded by US and British grifters, including James McCormick, as drug and bomb detectors and sold to some twenty countries, above all Iraq, where checkpoints relying on it failed to stop deadly bombings.

evidence.note: Chevreul's pendulum tests from 1808 begin the long 19th-century ideomotor debunking segment
spiritism, seances and table turning, Wallace and Hare fooled by mediums
digression on police drug dogs cueing on handlers, probable cause
the Gopher golf ball finder introduced, late 1980s or early 1990s
Gopher rebranded as Quadro Tracker and sold to US schools and police, 1993-1996
FBI debunks tracker in 1996; Rowe moves to England and joins the Trees
Bolton's GT200 marketed after 9/11 with Royal Engineers and embassy support
Iraq becomes top buyer via bribes, over 5,000 units
2009 Baghdad Ministry of Justice truck bomb passed a checkpoint using the device
Thai security forces used the devices to justify detaining people in the south
McCormick gets ten years; Egypt adaptation and 2014 Karachi airport attack follow

notes: Part One is mostly the history of the ideomotor effect (dowsing, spiritism, Clever Hans), listed as a secondary subject; covered_span starts at Chevreul in 1808 and leaves out the brief ancient dowsing background (2000 BCE onward). Arguably the whole 19th-century segment is background, which would start the span around 1990. Transcript renders Malcolm Stig Rowe and Wade Quaddlebaum; reporting spells Rowe and Quattlebaum. Gary Bolton's birth year is unknown.
